senses.sense_definition: Temporary, but with the intention of eventually becoming permanent or being replaced by a permanent equivalent.

examples.text: The team announced a <w>provisional</w> date for the meeting, pending final approval from the director.
They signed a <w>provisional</w> agreement while waiting for the lawyers to draft the final contract.

senses.sense_definition: An interim dental appliance used while waiting for a permanent one.

examples.text: The dentist fitted a <w>provisional</w> to protect the gum tissue during the healing process.
After the surgery, the patient wore a <w>provisional</w> until the permanent bridge was ready.

senses.sense_definition: A postage stamp issued locally before an official national issue is released.

examples.text: Collectors often search for a rare <w>provisional</w> from the early days of the postal service.
The local postmaster created a <w>provisional</w> to handle the sudden increase in mail volume.

senses.sense_definition: A member of the Provisional Irish Republican Army.

examples.text: The history books describe the actions taken by a <w>Provisional</w> during the conflict.
Many people in the region were affected by the activities of the <w>Provisional</w> group.

traits.comment: Refers to a specific historical paramilitary group in Ireland.
